15.t: Working with data: alkane or alkene?
q: Use CₙH₂ₙ and CₙH₂ₙ₊₂ to classify every sample.
Alkanes (CₙH₂ₙ₊₂): Q, S. Alkenes (CₙH₂ₙ): P, R. T fits neither: it is an alkyne (CₙH₂ₙ₋₂).
Explain why T reacted, and why it may need more bromine than P.
T has a triple bond, which can open twice: each C₂H₂ can add two Br₂ molecules, while ethene adds one.
